Opentext - The Information Company
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
 AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
 Your Impact
 Join us as a Senior Systems Administrator in Cluj, Romania where you will be part of a global Corporate Technology Platform Engineering Team. This position has the responsibility for administration, support, design, and planning, of the organization’s global production infrastructure. This 3rd level support position has the responsibility of being a subject matter expert in multiple platforms/systems, maintaining 24x7x365 system availability.
 What The Role Offers
Microsoft 365 tenant administration, ensuring operational health, performance, and security.
Recommends and implements policies and standards relating to Microsoft 365.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra, Active Directory and Exchange in a hybrid environment.
Provide 24/7 ‘tier3’ on-call support of specific production systems as required.
Design and implement technical solutions to support business requirements.
 What You Need To Succeed
Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or equivalent of work experience.
5+ years experience as a Senior Systems Administrator in a medium to large scale environment.
Expert knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Azure, including implementing, troubleshooting, and administration of the various applications and services.
Experience managing Copilot, Power Platform, SharePoint, Purview, and DLP in an enterprise.
Experience in implementing and managing Windows infrastructure services incl. Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File servers.
Expert knowledge of Windows Server administration, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Proficient at scripting for automation or user management in Powershell.
Strong team player, working in a globally dispersed team.
Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.
 Beneficial/preferred Qualifications
Experience configuring Enterprise Apps, SSO, and certificates.
Experience with Google Cloud Platform.
Experience with VMware or Hyper-V administration.
